answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the ember of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the quartz of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
